title: AWS Cloud Architect
jobDescription:
Wissen Technology is now hiring for AWS Cloud Architect with relevant experience. Location: Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune Experience
- 7 to 14 years. Required Skills: As a Cloud Engineer, you will work closely with other members of the Engineering and Product teams to help design, implement and operationalize our cloud platform. You will be involved in a wide array of challenging projects and will be responsible for building, enhancing and extending our cloud platform and CI/CD pipelines with the goal of moving changes to Production faster and safer, while ensuring operational best practices are supported within given timelines. The position is highly technical and focused on supporting agile software development. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record as a Software Engineer with extensive Cloud experience. The candidate will be a self-starter, able to act independently, and take ownership of key technology initiatives.
- 5+ years of cloud experience (AWS/Azure preferred)
- 3+ years of software development experience and expertise in a number of coding and scripting languages/frameworks including Python, Node.js, Typescript/Javascript, Bash
- Experience in Server less technologies including AWS Lambda
- Expertise with Kubernetes, Helm, and Docker
- Experience with monitoring tools/frameworks (Prometheus preferred)
- Experience in AWS Cloud Formation and Terraform with other AWS Services/Templates (infrastructure as code)
- Expertise in SDLC, CI/CD, and related activities (Git Hub/Git Hub Actions preferred).
- Knowledge of best practices and IT operations in an always-up, always-available service.
- Experience with data streaming and other distributed system architecture.
